CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_credit_score(
    p_score numeric,
    p_credit_utilization_ratio numeric,
    p_debt_ratio numeric,
    p_credit_age_years smallint,
    p_delinquency_count smallint,
    p_late_payment_count smallint,
    p_charge_offs smallint,
    p_bankruptcies smallint
)
RETURNS numeric AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN (
        -- Start with base score of 850
        850
        -- Deduct for delinquencies (each delinquency costs about 10 points)
        - (p_delinquency_count * 10)
        -- Deduct for late payments (each late payment costs about 5 points)
        - (p_late_payment_count * 5)
        -- Deduct for charge-offs (each charge-off costs about 20 points)
        - (p_charge_offs * 20)
        -- Deduct for bankruptcies (each bankruptcy costs about 50 points)
        - (p_bankruptcies * 50)
        -- Credit age bonus: up to 20 points based on years of credit history
        + LEAST(p_credit_age_years, 20)
        -- Credit utilization penalty: higher utilization reduces score
        - (p_credit_utilization_ratio * 100)
        -- Debt ratio penalty: higher debt ratio reduces score
        - (p_debt_ratio * 100)
    );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
